title: Agentic Engineering Day New Zealand
description:
Hi all,

We’re excited to bring [Agentic Engineering Day to New Zealand](https://www.agenticbuild.day/) this October 21–22, 2026 in Auckland.

Agentic Engineering Day is an independent, community-driven conference for software engineers, architects, builders, and curious minds exploring what it really means to work with AI systems in practice. From agents and emerging standards like MCP, SKILLS, to orchestration, evaluation, governance, observability & tracing, security, memory & context management and infrastructure - this is about the messy, real-world challenges of moving Cognitive Architectures out of the lab and into hardened, reliable production systems.

Whether you're experimenting with your first agent or scaling complex AI systems, this is a space to learn, share, and help shape the future of the local industry - together.

**Note:** Make sure to register to secure your seat! There is limited space available.

**[Agentic Engineering Day](https://www.agenticengineering.day/) (formerly Agentic Build Day)** is a paid event with community-priced tickets. Join us and support!

**Call for papers OPEN!**

If you're building agentic systems, shipping them into production, or pushing the boundaries of what autonomous AI can do, we want to hear about it.

Share what you're learning with the community and let’s build the future of agentic systems together.

Submissions are open now → https://www.agenticengineering.day/

title: Easy Panmure Basin Walk
location: 58 Waipuna Road, Mount Wellington, Auckland 1060, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
Join us at 2:00pm NZST for a relaxed nature walk around the Panmure Basin, exploring the waterfront path, some inclines, and scenic bridges, while conversation unfolds naturally along the way.

**Where to meet:** Waipuna Hotel and Conference Centre drop off area (see photo). 58 Waipuna Road, Mount Wellington, Auckland 1060. We start walking at 2:15pm sharp.

**Parking:** Plenty of spaces in front of the hotel.

**Public Transport:** 17 min walk from the Sylvia Park train station. 5 min walk from the 323 bus stop on Carbine Rd.

If you love photography, bring your camera or smartphone (charged) to snap some fun photos along the way.

This event is about moving at a comfortable pace, noticing what's around us, and letting conversation unfold organically as we walk. Conversation's an invitation here, never an obligation.

The walk has a light structure to help things flow, but nothing rigid. You're welcome to chat as much or as little as you like, and enjoy the experience your own way.

Running late? Use the Komoot route map below to catch us up, and keep an eye on the group as we move along the track.

Best suited to adults who are **moderately fit** and enjoy exploring nature and connecting through shared experiences and interests.

For those who want to keep hanging out after the walk, the Wellingtons Restaurant & Bar at the Waipuna Hotel offers excellent refreshments and beautiful views of the reserve.

Sometimes the day doesn't go entirely to plan - a path is closed, the group spreads out, the weather turns. That's part of it. Come as you are, keep an eye on the plan, and enjoy what's in front of you.

Can't wait to see who shows up.

title: Meaningful Connections Meetup
description:
* Not into small-talk, loud bars, social media and dating apps?
* Enjoy stimulating conversations, challenging yourself, learning new things?
* Want to spark up meaningful connections with interesting people?

Come and join us for an afternoon of meaningful connection with a group of interesting people. There will be conversations about things that matter, connection exercises, thought-provoking questions and a silly game or two to nudge you out of your comfort zone, in a safe and fun way!

It is a guided event - you won’t be stuck for what to do or what to talk about. Most of the talking will be done 1 on 1 in rotating pairs so you will have an opportunity to interact and connect with 10-15 people and go beyond small talk to get a deeper sense of who they are.

Perfect if you are new in town, a bit socially isolated due to work or circumstances, looking for new friends or someone special, or just want to venture outside of your familiar social circle.

You will have fun, enjoy getting to know new people on a below-the-surface level, learn more about yourself and increase your social skills and confidence.

Who knows, maybe you’ll make a new friend or even a romantic connection - but only if that happens naturally. The main purpose of this afternoon is good company, human connection and stimulating conversation. It is a no-pressure way to meet a bunch of new people.

title: Deep Dive into Jev & System One Models
description:
Looking for a chill but productive space to code, learn, and connect with other developers? Whether you’re just starting out or deep into a side project, you’re welcome here.

🔥 **This Fortnight's Spotlight: Jev & System One Models** Tired of wrestling with LLMs that hallucinate, break your JSON, and take 10 seconds to respond? This week, we're doing a quick 10-minute demo on **Jev** by TypeSafe AI—a brand new "System One" AI model.
Instead of acting like a chatbot that generates strings word-by-word, Jev acts like a lightning-fast function call. You give it unstructured data, and it outputs perfectly typed, probabilistic decisions in under 500 milliseconds. We'll look at why this parallel architecture is a game-changer for AI automation in your apps, and run a live demo of it in action.

🌟 **The Vibe & Details:** Alongside the demo, this remains a casual, community-driven space where you can:

• 💻 Work on your own coding projects
• 🎯 Share goals or progress (totally optional!)
• 🎙️ Talk tech, app development, and AI integration • ☕ Meet like-minded people over coffee

Come with your laptop, your curiosity, or just a love for tech. Stay for the connections and good vibes. No pressure, no strict schedule—just code, coffee, and vibes.

☕ *Note: This event is hosted at a local café, so we kindly ask that you support the venue by purchasing a drink or snack if you can.*

📅 We usually hold meetups every fortnight (bi-weekly)—use them to connect, share, and learn from others.

📚 **Want to geek out before you arrive? Check out these pre-reads:**
